svg.title: Before repeating a desktop action, check its delivery disposition
svg.desc: LiteBites-selected examples from Agent Desktop's delivery contract. Not_delivered means the requested input did not reach the app; after correcting the cause and following any recovery plan, retry can be safe. Delivery_uncertain or delivered_unverified requires observing live app state before deciding to act again. The unknown disposition also requires observation, and delivered_verified means the named postcondition was read back but repeating is unsafe. Delivery reports do not by themselves prove the whole task succeeded.

g.text: Did the action reach the app?
Two examples from the delivery contract.
Requested input did not reach the app.
Fix the cause; retry only if needed.
For a stale ref, first obtain a fresh snapshot.
The click may have happened already.
Read the live app before deciding.
A repeated click can duplicate a side effect.
delivered_verified → named effect read back; do not repeat.
A delivery report is not whole-task verification.
LiteBites synthesis · selected outcomes, not a performance claim
